mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_note (id, tenant_id, owner_id, agent_id, scope, memory_type, subject, content, structured_content, confidence, salience, status, version, previous_note_id, source, evidence_count, valid_from, valid_to, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{tenantId}, #{ownerId}, CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)NULL, #{scope}, #{memoryType}, #{subject}, #{content}, CAST(#{structuredContent} AS jsonb), #{confidence}, #{salience}, #{status}, #{version}, CAST(#{previousNoteId} AS uuid)NULL, #{source}, #{evidenceCount}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT *, structured_content::text AS structured_content FROM memory_note WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) OR agent_id IS NULL) AND to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(subject, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(content, '')) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) ORDER BY ts_rank_cd( to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(subject, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(content, '')), websearch_to_tsquery('simple', #{query}) ) DESC, salience DESC, confidence DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_note_evidence (id, note_id, event_id, evidence_role, evidence_excerpt, created_at) VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), CAST(#{noteId} AS uuid), CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid), #{evidenceRole}, #{evidenceExcerpt}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (note_id, event_id, evidence_role) DO NOTHING
